newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico, Japan formalise $500 mln eximbank credit.
newsitem.headline: Mexico, Japan formalise $500 mln eximbank credit.

text.p: Mexico and Japan formalised Monday a previously-announced credit for $500 million from the Export-Import Bank of Japan (Eximbank), Mexico's Finance Ministry said.

The credits were signed by Enrique Vilatela, director general of Mexico's foreign development bank Bancomext, Carlos Mendoza, assistant director of development bank Nafin, and Hiroshi Yasuda, governor of Japan's Eximbank.
The credits are split equally between Bancomext and Nafin and were announced during the recent visit to Mexico of Japan's Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto.
The credits are over eight years with three years' grace and subject to a variable interest rate of not more than LIBOR plus one percentage point, the ministry said.
